message.content: Help me execute the jar agent with the options 'trace' and 'log' for instrumentation purposes in a Java application, assuming the instrumentation object is named `appInstrumentation`?

function.name: AbstractJarAgent_runJarAgent
function.description: Runs the jar agent with the specified options and attaches it to the provided Instrumentation instance. It initializes common parameters, performs test-specific initialization, and starts a special thread for test-specific actions. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

options.description: The options for the jar agent, separated by spaces. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

inst.description: The Instrumentation instance to which the agent will be attached. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
